dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with thin, high-intensity perimeters. Geometry is irregular, showing sharp transitions from the dark charcoal background to light-colored borders, often enclosing a slightly darker interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the mid-ventral and posterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary group of four annuli in the anterior-mid section forms an irregular quadrilateral.
